episodes.title: When Metrics Start Distorting the Business
episodes.description: When a metric becomes a target, it can distort the behaviour it was meant to improve. A discussion of KPIs, incentives and operational decision-making.

episodes.title: When Efficiency Makes Operations Fragile
episodes.description: Why leaner systems can become more vulnerable when supplier concentration, staffing buffers and spare capacity are overlooked.

episodes.title: When Management Attention Becomes the Bottleneck
episodes.description: How approvals, meetings and fragmented information consume managerial attention—and what deserves that attention in the first place.

episodes.title: The Cost of Complexity When More Choice Makes Operations Worse
episodes.description: What SKU proliferation, extra suppliers and duplicated workflows quietly cost an organisation.

episodes.title: Rules Versus Reality on the Frontline
episodes.description: Why written SOPs often diverge from frontline execution and how organisations can balance consistency with local judgement.
